meaning: Bounds on the additional cross-solver scaling difference after subtracting nominal conversion error. These characterize the fixed synthetic pose grid, not general biomechanical equivalence or clinical accuracy.
justification: Round measured maxima upward with a small numerical margin. Every metric bound is exercised against a 5% tibia-factor error, an anisotropic femur-axis swap, or a 3% muscle lengthrange error. Nominal conversion errors remain separately reported. The torque bounds cover only the six listed muscles at activation one.
